lines.text: The LORD tells Moses that any Israelite or foreigner in Israel who gives children to Molech must be stoned.
If the people hide their eyes and spare that man, the LORD sets His face against him and his family.
The LORD says to be holy, and whoever curses his brother or sister must be put to death.
The LORD says the land won't vomit Israel out, and Israel will inherit the land of the Egyptians.

wrong_details.true: the land of the nations He is driving out
